turns.comment: This used to set mode='delivery' and address='Ladyville?', and because tryCheckout fast-tracks once BOTH are set, it then skipped straight past the pickup/delivery question AND the address question -- sending a real driver to a literal question mark. Step staying at 'item' proves there was no fast-track; the null fields prove nothing was committed.

turns.in: how much is delivery to my house?
turns.comment: Second question phrasing that carries both a delivery word and a place.

The control, and the reason the guard keys off question FORM rather than just the delivery keyword: a genuine instruction to deliver somewhere still has to commit, or the fix would have broken one-message ordering entirely.
